ideas.idea: Make blog a server component, load posts server-side, export metadata, add per-post routes with Article JSON-LD
ideas.why: Blog is a client component with useEffect fetch; server rendering and per-post pages with metadata make content visible to crawlers.

ideas.idea: Remove /blog from sitemap until real posts exist
ideas.why: Minor housekeeping that depends on whether posts exist, with limited effect.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Disallow groups for other training crawlers (Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, meta-externalagent)
ideas.why: geo.config.json declares trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the policy isn't fully enforced.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for AI search bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot)
ideas.why: They are already allowed via `*`, so explicit groups add very little.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD Organization/WebSite in layout and SoftwareApplication with Offer on home and pricing
ideas.why: There is no structured data in the repo, and this describes what Ledger is and its free tier to machines.

ideas.idea: Expand thin page content: features, plan table with prices, who it's for, FAQ, h2 sections, real docs setup steps
ideas.why: Pages are thin, but the advice pushes a mandatory FAQ and padding as a citation tactic, which is folklore.

ideas.idea: Use a title template and more descriptive page titles/descriptions, and stop repeating the same generic description
ideas.why: Docs and Pricing titles are bare, and layout and home share an identical description.

ideas.idea: Set canonical via alternates in layout metadata ('./') as the way to fix docs canonical
ideas.why: A layout-level relative canonical is inherited by all child pages and would give every page the same canonical, which is risky.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter metadata
ideas.why: Applies to nearly any site and mostly affects social previews.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap and generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: Reasonable but common advice with small effect for a four-URL sitemap.
The user said no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is folklore as a way to be found.
